snapshot: revised drafts in this working tree

criticalIssues: Q4 introduces possession and use of an e-mail address. The passage establishes written messages on a computer, but the school is shown asking only for a phone number and the channel is unspecified. Mention e-mail during registration or ask about a written message without specifying the channel.
Q1 has a question–answer grammar mismatch in every option. The stem O czym jest cały tekst? calls for O + locative, but all three answers are bare accusative noun phrases.
Q3’s only supported option repeats the meaning of dostawa do domu. It misses the cause/purpose construct and partly gives away Q5.

Q4 supplies an unsupported detail by assuming the mother intends to give the son food to eat at work. The text supports the sandwiches as the only meal option, while the intended place of eating is unstated.

Q4 gives Ola's finish time and says she works in the morning, but gives no start time. Only Marek is the expected answer, yet the schedule does not establish that Ola is working at 11:00. Give her a shift spanning that time.

Q5's present-tense stem asks which camera already belongs to the narrator, but the passage says only that the narrator wants to buy one, and B describes a future purchase. Ask 'Co autor ma na myśli, mówiąc o własnym aparacie?' or use a conditional ownership scenario.
Missing closing comma after jedziemy in „sprawdzić pogodę tam, dokąd jedziemy i zapisać”. Write „sprawdzić pogodę tam, dokąd jedziemy, i zapisać”.
„Każdy odpowiada na te, które pasują do jego możliwości” has no explicit antecedent for te. Supply „na te prośby, które pasują do jego możliwości” or „odpowiada, gdy może w czymś pomóc”.

Q4 is ambiguous. A clearly works, but B can also work if the brother brings the bag to Emilia after shopping while she is still out. The stem does not require returning the bottle before shopping or forbid help during the outing.
The passage has an unnatural verb–object combination in bibliotekarka najpierw opowiedziała kilka zdań o autorze. Use powiedziała kilka zdań o autorze or krótko opowiedziała o autorze.
